name: Verity Building Surveyors
description: Building surveying and project management firm in the fictional town of Calder Brook.

items.title: Survey types and fees
items.content: A level 2 survey costs $590 and a level 3 survey $945; reports arrive in about 6 working days. Price list VBS-FEE-2.

items.title: Office hours
items.content: The office at 9 Tannery Yard opens 08:45 to 17:05 on weekdays. Card VBS-OFF-9.

items.title: Report quality checks
items.content: Every report is peer reviewed within 48 hours by Maeve Fallon or Tobias Grey before release. Process VBS-QC-48.

items.title: Drone survey rules
items.content: Drone flights need a permit logged in VBS-DRN-120 and stay below 120 metres; the pilot is Kian Byrne.

items.title: Office lease break clause
items.content: The Tannery Yard lease has a break option on 2027-09-29 with 6 months' notice; rent is $2,450 a month. Lease VBS-LSE-0929.

items.title: Professional negligence claim
items.content: A buyer of 12 Willow Crescent claims $96,000 because our surveyor missed subsidence; our insurer, Keystone Indemnity, has reserved $70,000. File VBS-NEG-1212-W.
